findings.reason: a worker following the plan will create `model_windows.yaml` or `.json`, keep the leak test red, and its gate cannot pass, so the section fails for a reason the plan created rather than one it predicted.
findings.text: §69 moves the window figures to "one new data file under `reckon/crew/` that the package ships", but `test_no_routing_identifier_leaks_into_skills_or_source` (tests/test_skill_contracts.py:356-374) rglobs all of `reckon/` and scans every file whose suffix is `.py`, `.md`, `.yaml` or `.json`; a data file in the natural `.yaml`/`.json` form carrying `claude-opus-5`, `claude-sonnet-5` or `claude-haiku-5` re-trips `ROUTING_IDENTIFIERS` (`\b(sonnet|opus|haiku)\b`), so the test stays red and the done-when ("`tests/test_skill_contracts.py` passes in full") cannot be met; the only escape is a suffix outside the scan set (e.g. `.toml`/`.csv`), which the plan never states, and the alternative — adding the file to `LEAKAGE_EXEMPT` — contradicts the same done-when's "git diff … adds only the exemption row described above", since that row is the `crew station` verb row in `CREW_VERBS_OUTSIDE_ORCHESTRATION`
